name: ledger4-needs-you-dark
js: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ledgerfilt button')).find(x => /needs you/.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); })()

name: ledger5-settle-focus-cream
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.ledger .histwrap.stl .histrow'); if (b) b.focus(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); })()

name: ledger6-project-menu-dark
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.ledgerfilt .scopepill .cchip'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); })()

name: ledger7-overlay-dark
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.navhistfind'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); })()

name: ledger8-typing-dark
js: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.stagebox textarea'); if (!ta) return; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(ta, 'Draft three LinkedIn posts about the v0.128 release and schedule them for next week.'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); ta.focus(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); })()

name: ledger9-show-more-dark
js: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.stagewrap'); if (w) w.scrollTop = w.scrollHeight; return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); })()

name: ledger10-shown-more-cream
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.ledgermore'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const w = document.querySelector('.stagewrap'); if (w) w.scrollTop = w.scrollHeight; setTimeout(r, 400); }, 300)); })()

name: ledger11-mention-dark
js: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.stagebox textarea'); if (!ta) return; ta.focus(); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(ta, '@'); ta.setSelectionRange(1, 1); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); })()
